summary: Implemented orchestrator/dev_supervisor/resolve_discovery.py (injectable process/socket/MCP transports, OBSERVED/UNAVAILABLE labelling, MATCH/MISMATCH/UNCONFIGURED/UNAVAILABLE identity verdict, never by name alone, require_match refuses MISMATCH, CLI with exit codes 0/1/2/3, --start-bridge launches only the Resolve app and always prints the manual bridge steps) plus 60 offline tests and RESOLVE_BOOTSTRAP.md. Live read-only observation (OBSERVED): Resolve Free 21.0.4.5 GUI running, 1 instance; TCP connect to 127.0.0.1:49632 succeeded (no bytes sent); MCP read calls answered; database Local Database (Disk); current project is the T-RSV-002 disposable probe project (CS_T-RSV-002_ntsc_probe) with a UUID id exposed by get_current, current timeline N2; project list holds 7 projects incl. MCP_COMPATIBILITY_TEST. So the intended project MCP_COMPATIBILITY_TEST is NOT the open one; discovery CLI with a config expecting it returned MISMATCH exit 1, with no config UNCONFIGURED exit 2. Root cause (INFERRED, partly REPORTED): launching Resolve starts only the app; the bridge needs the user to run Workspace > Scripts > resolve_bridge; identity is whatever project is open (changed by other tasks) and no identity config existed. NOT TESTED: raw reply on port 49632 (authenticated), folder identity, a real MCP client in the CLI (it takes an agent-supplied snapshot). Nothing VERIFIED beyond the cited command outputs.
